Package org.uma.evolver.example.tutorial

Class BudgetsTutorial

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.example.tutorial.BudgetsTutorial
public class BudgetsTutorial extends Object
Code of tutorial E17, "Budgets: evaluations or time" (see docs/tutorials/budgets.rst).

It runs the training of tutorial E3 (NSGA-II tuned for ZDT4 by NSGA-II) with the meta-optimizer bounded by computing time instead of by meta-evaluations, and reads how it stopped: the status file, the stopping condition recorded in METADATA.txt, and the computing time of each checkpoint in VAR_CONF.txt.

The comments // [step-N-start]/// [step-N-end] delimit the fragments that the tutorial page includes; keep them when editing this class.
